review.original:
Dear Appeals Unit:

I am Rosa Rivera, a member of Bluewater Medicare Advantage HMO. I am appealing the denial dated 2026-10-20, case number SIM-PA-20431, for home health physical therapy. My member ID is BWM-77031882.

On homebound status, I live alone and Alex visits twice a week. Leaving home takes a considerable and taxing effort for me.

On a doctor-certified plan of care, my treating doctor is Dr. Samuel Okafor of Harbor Light Internal Medicine. A letter of medical necessity was requested from his office, reference R-17296, to be signed by the doctor and faxed from the office.

On the need for skilled therapy to restore or keep my function, please see my doctor's letter of medical necessity and my medical records, which I enclose.

On whether the services are reasonable and necessary for my condition, please see the same enclosed doctor's letter and medical records.

I disagree with the reason that I am not homebound and do not need skilled therapy at home. I am enclosing the doctor's letter of medical necessity, medical records, and the denial notice.

Please review my appeal and send me your decision in writing.

objections.rule: A doctor has certified a plan of care for the therapy.
objections.reason: R2 is not met because the letter only states a letter of medical necessity was requested from Dr. Okafor (R-17296) to be signed and faxed, not that the doctor has certified a plan of care.
objections.needs: A signed doctor certification of the plan of care for therapy

objections.rule: Skilled therapy is needed to restore or keep the member's function.
objections.reason: R3 is not met because the letter does not make the case that skilled therapy is needed and instead relies on a vague referral to see the enclosed doctor's letter and medical records.
objections.needs: Specific statement in the letter explaining why skilled therapy is needed to restore or keep function and naming the enclosed doctor's letter/records as support

objections.rule: The services are reasonable and necessary for the member's condition.
objections.reason: R4 is not met because the letter does not make the case that services are reasonable and necessary and instead relies on a vague referral to see the same enclosed doctor's letter and medical records.
objections.needs: Specific statement in the letter explaining why the services are reasonable and necessary for the condition and naming the enclosed doctor's letter/records as support

todos: A signed doctor certification of the plan of care for therapy (for the plan's rule: "A doctor has certified a plan of care for the therapy").

Specific statement in the letter explaining why skilled therapy is needed to restore or keep function and naming the enclosed doctor's letter/records as support (for the plan's rule: "Skilled therapy is needed to restore or keep the member's function").

Specific statement in the letter explaining why the services are reasonable and necessary for the condition and naming the enclosed doctor's letter/records as support (for the plan's rule: "The services are reasonable and necessary for the member's condition").
review.note: Every reason left needs evidence that isn't on file yet; rewording can't fix that.
